theorem.statement: There is a jointly measurable implementation of \(\mathrm{def:implementation\text{-}handle}\) with the stipulated coordinate order, parent-only recursion, lexicographic child order, and separate testing of every closed child containing a shared-boundary point. For each fixed depth \(k\), its selected ambient boxes and feasible cells equal \(\mathcal D_j^\dagger\) and \(\mathcal C_j^\dagger\), respectively, for all \(j\le k\) with probability tending to one locally uniformly on every bounded nuisance fiber. Define the population prefix gaps \(\gamma_j(L)\) as in the proof and let \(j_n(L)\) be the largest certified depth for which the approximation envelope is smaller than all preceding positive prefix gaps. Then \(a_n(L)=\sup_{m\ge n}2^{-j_m(L)}\downarrow0\) and \(\lVert\widehat r_n-r^\dagger\rVert=O_P(a_n(L))\) locally uniformly. This conclusion includes disconnected, flat, tied, and dyadic-boundary minimizing sets. A jointly refined rectangle-constant Gaussian rule has risk error \(o(1)\) uniformly over every fixed bounded nuisance fiber. The final rate limitation is only a generic continuous-objective statement: on \([0,1]\), continuity and uniform objective-approximation control alone imply no spatial recovery modulus tending to zero uniformly over all continuous objectives, because for every \(\epsilon>0\), \(f_+(z)=\epsilon z\) and \(f_-(z)=\epsilon(1-z)\) have canonical minimizers zero and one while \(g(z)=\epsilon/2\) is within \(\epsilon/2\) uniformly of both. No model-specific impossibility over the Gaussian-risk family \(r\mapsto L(r)\) is asserted.
theorem.justification: The construction gives a jointly measurable deterministic-limit selector, stabilizes every fixed nested-cell prefix at nonunique and boundary optima, supplies a law-specific spatial rate, and couples the selector to a slowly refining Gaussian rectangle rule.
theorem.gap: The selector rate depends on the objective's certified prefix-separation profile. The proof's counterexample establishes only that generic continuity plus uniform objective-approximation control cannot yield an objective-uniform spatial recovery modulus; it makes no model-specific impossibility claim for the Gaussian-risk family.
theorem.consumer: This theorem supplies the implementable design and decision schedule required by the full-nuisance attainment theorem.
